verdict.rationale: Installed plugins add skills and MCP tools that are used inside natural-language Chat/Work sessions in ChatGPT and Codex, for example asking the Slack plugin to summarize channels or draft replies. Skills are picked automatically from their name and description, or invoked in plain language, as a community user reports ("use the PR skill to open a PR"). The @plugin-creator and skill-creator flows build plugins and skills through a conversation. Missing for 10: plugin discovery and management relies on slash commands (/plugins), $-mentions, the CLI (`codex plugin marketplace add`) or a UI tab rather than plain-language requests; there is no hands-on probe confirming natural-language operation end-to-end.
